description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named TicketController for managing ticket-related operations within a web application. It handles HTTP GET and POST requests for rendering forms, saving, editing, and deleting tickets, and includes security integration to identify the logged-in user.

classes.name: TicketController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling CRUD operations and form rendering for Ticket entities, with security context integration.

methods.name: showTicketForm
methods.description: Handles GET request to render create/edit ticket form; loads existing ticket if ticketId provided, otherwise initializes new Ticket object.

methods.name: saveTicket
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a Ticket; sets creation date if new before persisting.

methods.name: editTicket
methods.description: Handles GET request to render ticket details in a form for editing, setting readOnly flag as true.

methods.name: deleteTicket
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a Ticket by ID.

methods.name: getLoggedUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently authenticated user's ID from the security context.
